title: Riverside Community Centre
text:
RIVERSIDE COMMUNITY CENTRE
Summer courses – July and August

Cooking for beginners
Learn to make easy and healthy meals. Tuesdays, 6–8 p.m. Price: £60 for 6 lessons (food included). Maximum 10 people.

Photography
Bring your camera or phone and learn how to take better photos. Saturdays, 10 a.m. – 12 p.m. Price: £45 for 4 lessons. Some lessons are outside, so wear comfortable clothes.

Spanish for travellers
Useful words and phrases for your holiday. Mondays and Wednesdays, 7–8 p.m. Price: £50 for 8 lessons. No experience needed.

Yoga in the park
Every Sunday at 9 a.m. in Riverside Park. Free! Bring a mat and some water. If it rains, the class is in the main hall.

How to book: Visit the reception (open Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. – 5 p.m.) or call 0161 496 0723. Students and people over 65 get a 20% discount on all paid courses.
